scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others -n backend,desktop -c blue,green "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:desktop"
scripts.dev:backend: env UV_CACHE_DIR=.uv-cache uv run --project apps/backend uvicorn --app-dir apps/backend gunther.main:app --reload --port 8787
scripts.test:backend: env GUNTHER_DESKTOP_SIDECAR=1 UV_CACHE_DIR=.uv-cache uv run --project apps/backend pytest apps/backend
scripts.backup:data: env UV_CACHE_DIR=.uv-cache uv run --project apps/backend python scripts/backup_gunther.py backup
scripts.verify:backup: env UV_CACHE_DIR=.uv-cache uv run --project apps/backend python scripts/backup_gunther.py verify
scripts.restore:data: env UV_CACHE_DIR=.uv-cache uv run --project apps/backend python scripts/backup_gunther.py restore
scripts.lint: env UV_CACHE_DIR=.uv-cache uv run --project apps/backend ruff check apps/backend && npm run typecheck -w @gunther/desktop
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm test && npm run test:desktop && npm run build && npm run check:desktop
